quotations.old_english: Se mon geswógunga þrówaþ and módes geswæðrunga
quotations.english: the man suffers swoonings and failings of the mind

source_text: ge-swæðrung, e; f. A failing, a want; del&i-short;quium :-- Se mon geswógunga þrówaþ and módes geswæðrunga the man suffers swoonings and failings of the mind, L. M. 2, 21; Lchdm. ii. 206, 9. v. ge-sweðerian.
